purpose: Establish a reproducible physical RTX 4060 Laptop GPU video benchmark without reusing 5080 runner state or receipts.

public_claim_policy.not_yet_claimable: No present evidence proves that this or every 8 GB GPU can run a video model.
public_claim_policy.claim_after_pass: This exact physical RTX 4060 Laptop GPU configuration ran the named candidate at the measured settings.
never_infer: 5080 reserve-vram or clamp evidence is not physical 8 GB evidence.
One cold run is not a reliable 8 GB result.
A result for one laptop is not a result for every 8 GB GPU.

required_media_checks: exact frame count, dimensions, FPS, and duration
no black, grid, tile, colour, or audio defect applicable to the plan

future_boot_policy.argv: direct argv list only; never cmd.exe or a shell command string
future_boot_policy.state: all PID, lock, output, log, receipt, and model-manifest state is under eightgb_bench/local on the laptop checkout
